request_state.conjecture: Beal: A^x + B^y = C^z with x,y,z >= 3 and gcd(gcd(A,B),C) = 1 has no solutions. Audit has shown three recurring failure modes in this project: conflating a residual mod-p congruence with an isogeny or l-adic statement; using a Chabauty rank bound over a base field to conclude about points of higher degree; and relabelling a GRH-conditional or heuristic result as unconditional.

candidate_A.claim: The larger-base-field escape from C174/C175 is REAL and CHEAP, so the regularity obstruction is a statement about Q and not a field-independent fact. Over K the orbits of primitive m-th roots have size |Gal(K(zeta_m)/K)| = phi(m)/[K cap Q(zeta_m):Q], so the minimal rank drops; reconciling the largest exponent's rank with the smallest one's ceiling needs only [K:Q] >= phi(r)/p, which is between 2 and 6 for every pairwise distinct triple of reduced exponents up to 19.
candidate_A.method: Exact computation of both measures in code/U319_base_field_escape.py over all 56 pairwise distinct triples from {3,4,5,7,11,13,17,19}. Measure 1 (K contains all three roots of unity) costs phi(lcm(p,q,r)) = (p-1)(q-1)(r-1), ranging 16 to 3456 -- confirmed equal for all 56 triples. Measure 2 (K only shrinks the largest orbit enough) costs ceil(phi(r)/p), ranging 2 to 6. Measure 2 is the binding one.
candidate_A.evidence: Measure 1's quantity is already machine-checked as Beal.minBaseDegree_le_triple and Beal.totient_mul_primes in formal/Beal/Rigidity.lean. Measure 2 is a division bound, computed exactly here and not formalised.
candidate_A.obligations: CORRECTION TO MY OWN FRAMING: C174 and C175 must be read as statements about Q. I flagged this escape as 'likely live' in the previous cycle and it is. What the escape does NOT do is remove the obstruction -- over K the modular method still needs automorphy of an n-dimensional motive with n > 2 (C171), now over K rather than Q, which is harder. This is consistent with the literature: the (5,5,p) work uses Q(sqrt 5) at RANK 2 and stops there. Untested: whether a degree 2-6 field can carry a Frey object for three independent exponents with the residual representation the method needs; and whether descent to Q of the resulting statement is possible at all, since the Beal solution itself lives over Q.
candidate_A.novelty: Prevents the repeat of the U258 failure mode: reporting only the expensive measure would have overstated the obstruction exactly as U258 did before U309 caught it. Records the escape as open with its cost quantified, rather than claiming a closure that is not there.

compatible.instructions: Are these two research candidates mathematically COMPATIBLE, in the sense that the objects, fields, exponents and equations they concern are the same or are related by a reduction that the project has already proved?

criteria.true: they concern the same equation, signature, curve or field, or one supplies an input the other consumes
criteria.false: they concern unrelated equations, signatures or methods, so no joint statement could be formed without inventing a new reduction

combination_value.instructions: If these two candidates were combined into a single line of attack, how much would the combination accomplish beyond what the better of the two accomplishes alone?
criteria: level 0: nothing; the combination is just the stronger candidate restated, or they are incompatible
level 1: the combination tidies bookkeeping but resolves no obligation that either one leaves open
level 2: one candidate discharges a specific open obligation recorded in the other
level 3: the combination closes a case or an infinite family that neither one closes alone

shared_failure.instructions: Would these two candidates FAIL FOR THE SAME REASON, so that combining them adds no diversity of failure mechanism and a single obstruction would defeat both?

criteria.true: both depend on the same blocked step, the same unverified citation, or the same one of the three recorded failure modes
criteria.false: they would fail for different reasons, so each provides genuine independent information
